keyed.HH.Thrumbo.HowTo.Title: How to play: {0}
keyed.HH.Thrumbo.HowTo.Slots:
Set your stake and pull the lever (or press Spin). Three reels stop one after another; only the middle row counts.

• Three of a kind pay what the paytable shows: berries the least, the thrumbo the most.
• Berries are kind: two on reels 1 and 2, or one on reel 1, still pay a little back.
• Volatility changes how the payout is spread, not how much comes back in the long run: low pays small amounts often, high pays rarely but big.

In the long run the machine pays back the share shown above the paytable; the rest is the house edge.
keyed.HH.Thrumbo.HowTo.Roulette:
Click a number or a field on the board to place your stake there, then spin. The ball lands in one pocket.

• A single number pays 35 to 1.
• Dozens and columns (12 numbers) pay 2 to 1.
• Red or black, odd or even, 1–18 or 19–36 pay 1 to 1.
• The green zero (and the double zero on an American wheel) belongs to no colour and no half: that is where the house edge comes from.

Every bet has the same house edge; only the swings differ.
keyed.HH.Thrumbo.HowTo.Blackjack:
Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Number cards count their number, jack, queen and king count 10, an ace counts 1 or 11.

• Hit: take another card. Stand: keep what you have; the dealer then reveals the face-down card and draws until 17 or more.
• Double down: on your first two cards, double the stake and take exactly one more card.
• Over 21 is a bust and loses at once. An ace with a ten-card is a blackjack and pays a bonus (3 to 2 at standard tables).
• A tie is a push: you get your stake back.

Playing well matters here: the edge shown is for perfect play.
keyed.HH.Thrumbo.HowTo.Poker:
Rimdeck is poker against the other players, not against the house. Everyone antes the same stake; each player gets two cards, then five shared cards come face up in the middle (three, one and one more).

• The best five of your seven cards win the pot: high card, a pair, two pair, three of a kind, a straight, a flush, a full house, four of a kind, a straight flush (from weak to strong).
• Sharper minds win a little more often: Intellectual and Social skill tilt the odds.
• The house only keeps a small rake from each pot.
keyed.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.HowTo.Slots:
Choose the things to stake on the left, then a volatility, then press the button. One spin of the three reels decides.

• Three of a kind (or berries on the first reels) multiply the value of your stake as in the Lucky Thrumbo paytable.
• Win ×2 or more: everything stays with you and the house pays value × (m − 1) in silver.
• No win: the things leave with the house. A small prize below ×1 is paid in silver, the things are still gone.
keyed.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.HowTo.Roulette:
Choose the things to stake on the left, then one of the outside bets, then press the button. One spin of the wheel decides.

• Red or black, odd or even, 1–18 or 19–36 pay 1 to 1: win, and you keep everything plus its value in silver.
• A dozen (12 numbers) pays 2 to 1: you keep everything plus twice its value.
• The green zero (and the double zero) belongs to no bet here: that is the house edge.
• Lose, and the things leave with the house as if you had sold them.

defs.NeedDef/HH_Need_Gambling.label: gambling
defs.NeedDef/HH_Need_Gambling.description: Because of a gambling addiction, this person needs to sit at a table or a machine regularly. The deeper the addiction, the faster the need falls.
defs.HediffDef/HH_GamblingAddiction.label: gambling addiction
defs.HediffDef/HH_GamblingAddiction.descripti: The tables have taken hold. Without regular play the withdrawal sets in: bad mood, short temper and, at the deepest stages, gambling sprees. Only time without a single session cures it, and a relapse is easy during the craving period afterwards.\n\nIt costs no silver, only time, mood and nerves.
I keep thinking about the tables. One game would not hurt.
I cannot concentrate. I need to play.
Everything is grey except the wheel.
My hands shake. Somebody must have a deck of cards.
defs.MentalStateDef/HH_GamblingSpree.label: gambling spree
defs.MentalStateDef/HH_GamblingSpree.beginLet: {0} cannot stay away from the tables any longer and is going on a gambling spree, ignoring every rule of the drug policy.
defs.Hearth.Casino.HelpHintDef/HH_HelpHint_Ga: Shown quietly on every screen where you gamble.
defs.ThingDef/HH_SlotMachine.label: one-armed muffalo
defs.ThingDef/HH_SlotMachine.description: A coin-guzzling slot machine with three reels and a lever shaped like a muffalo horn. The odds are fixed by the house, the lights are not. Guests play without a croupier; colonists play with worthless house chips.\n\nChoose its volatility (how often and how big it pays) with the button on the machine.
defs.ThingDef/HH_RouletteTable.label: roulette table
defs.ThingDef/HH_RouletteTable.description: A felt layout with a wheel set into it. Place your chips; the ball decides. Needs a croupier (a colonist working the Serving work type) to run for guests. Colonists can play for joy with house chips without one.
defs.ThingDef/HH_BlackjackTable.label: blackjack table
defs.ThingDef/HH_BlackjackTable.description: A half-moon table with a card shoe. Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Good players lose less; the house edge depends on the rules and on how well the player plays. Needs a croupier for guests.
defs.ThingDef/HH_PokerTable.label: Rimdeck table
defs.ThingDef/HH_PokerTable.description: The house deals Rimdeck, a card game played against the other players: the house only keeps a small rake from every pot. Clever and sociable players win more often. Replaces the vanilla poker table. Needs a croupier for guests.
defs.ThingDef/HH_CashierCage.label: cashier's cage
defs.ThingDef/HH_CashierCage.description: A barred window where silver becomes chips and back. With a cage in the colony, guests play with chips: they bring about 5 % more and a few leave with chips that are worthless outside the house (the chip float stays in the till). The nightly takings of the casino are put down here as silver.
defs.ThingDef/HH_CasinoChips.label: casino chip
defs.ThingDef/HH_CasinoChips.description: A clay chip stamped with the mark of a house. Worth one silver at the cage that sold it and nothing anywhere else: traders will not touch it and it does not count toward your wealth.
defs.ThingDef/HH_GamblingSession.label: gambling
defs.ThingDef/HH_GamblingSession.description: A session at the tables, managed through drug policies like a drug: whether it is allowed for fun, how often, and whether people who are addicted may play. This is not an item and never exists in the world.
defs.JoyKindDef/HH_Gambling.label: gambling
defs.WorkGiverDef/HH_RunCasinoTable.label: run casino tables
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_WonAtTheTables.stages.0.de: The chips fell my way. For once.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_LostAtTheTables.stages.0.l: lost it all at the tables
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_LostAtTheTables.stages.0.d: Every chip, gone. They were free, and it still stings.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Casino_Slots.label: slot machines
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Casino_Slots.descr: Build One-Armed Muffalo slot machines: electric, noisy, and very good at turning loose silver into house profit.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Casino_Tables.desc: Build roulette, blackjack and Rimdeck tables and a cashier's cage. Tables need a croupier to run for guests.

defs.TraderKindDef/HH_Pawnbroker.description: Values what you put on the table at the Lucky Thrumbo: the price a trader would pay, minus the house's spread.
